# Welcome {.unnumbered}


This book contains the **Open and Reproducible Science in R** workshop materials.
In 90 minutes, we follow the `HealthWellbeing` dataset through an
end-to-end reproducible research workflow. We start with Git and
GitHub, including a short activity in which you read the workshop's
history. Short demonstrations then cover computational environments, FAIR
metadata, and data and model versioning. In the hands-on exercises, you
complete and run a `targets` meta-analysis pipeline, render a Quarto
report from its outputs, then change the analysis and reproduce the
results. We finish
with releases, archiving, and discussion. A supplementary exercise
covers synthetic data with `synthpop`.

## Getting started

Read the learning objectives and programme, then open the prepared
MyBinder environment before the session. Some familiarity with R will
help you follow the material.
[Introduction](pages/1_introduction.qmd) ·
[Preparation](pages/workshop/00_preparation.qmd)

Use the book navigation to move between chapters. A PDF download is available
from the HTML book's download menu once both output formats have been rendered.
The PDF contains the same configured chapters in a single document.

## People and community

See the [coordinators](pages/2_coordinators.qmd) for presenter and co-author
